name: Ory Hydra Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect server core for issuing tokens, client management, consent and login integration; no hosted-user quota.
watch_out: Requires a separate login/consent application, database and your own infrastructure. Ory recommends an enterprise agreement for business-critical deployments needing guaranteed CVE fixes, SLAs and advanced features; managed Ory Network is separate.
